high_water_definition: Training-level 90th percentile, not an official flood threshold
rise_definition: Training positive 1h change 75th percentile with minimum 0.02 m/h
heavy_rain_definition: Observed prior-6h point rainfall at least 30 mm; not catchment rainfall
rainfall_forecasts: Excluded: historical issuance/availability archive not verified
status: Retrospective research evaluation; no operational certification; final test never used to select hyperparameters
pooled_models: Evaluate common chronological periods and scale-free deltas only; no held-out-station transfer claim without separate testing
